models.name: todo_app_users
models.description:
Registered user accounts with email/password authentication credentials, email verification status, and account security settings.

Stores identity information for authenticated individual users who can create, read, update, and delete their own todo items. Each user has exclusive ownership of their data with no access to other users' information.

This actor table serves as the canonical identity record for the user type in the system, with related session, password reset, and email verification tables managing authentication workflows. The primary key is a UUID for distributed system compatibility and security.

Users must verify their email address before their account becomes fully active, and they can reset their password through a secure time-limited email link.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: User's unique email address used for authentication and communication. Must be unique across all users and follow standard email format.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Securely hashed password for authentication. Never stored in plain text. Generated using bcrypt or equivalent secure algorithm.

plainFields.name: email_verified
plainFields.description: Indicates whether the user has verified their email address. Initially false upon registration; set to true after successful email verification through the token system.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was created. Cannot be modified after account creation.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last update to the user account. Updated whenever the user modifies any account details.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was soft-deleted. If null, the account is active. Used to preserve data integrity while allowing account removal.

models.name: todo_app_user_sessions
models.description:
JWT session tokens for user authentication stored in httpOnly cookies, with access token expiration set to 15 minutes.

Tracks the login sessions for authenticated users. Each session represents a single device/browser login with precise connection context.

Sessions are append-only audit records - never modified or deleted. The system automatically expires sessions after 15 minutes of inactivity (as specified).

This table is managed exclusively by the authentication system during login/logout flows, not through direct user interaction.

Does not store token contents, password hashes, or user credentials - only connection metadata and lifecycle timestamps.

foreignFields.name: user_id
foreignFields.description: The user's {@link todo_app_users.id} who owns this session.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client's IP address from which the session was established.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: The URL from which the user initiated the login session.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: The previous web page from which the user navigated to this application.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this session was created and authenticated.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this session will expire automatically. Fixed at 15 minutes after created_at as per specification. Sessions are invalidated upon expiration and cannot be refreshed.

models.name: todo_app_user_password_resets
models.description:
Password reset tokens with 1-hour expiration for secure password recovery workflow, invalidated after use.

Each password reset request generates a unique token that the user receives via email. The token is valid for exactly 60 minutes and can only be used once. After successful password reset, the token is immediately and permanently deleted from the system. The system automatically purges expired tokens during maintenance windows.

Tokens provide a secure alternative to password transmission, ensuring that only users with access to the registered email can reset their passwords. This mechanism complies with security best practices for authentication workflows.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_user_id
foreignFields.description: The user who requested the password reset. {@link todo_app_users.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique random string token generated for password reset. This token is sent to the user via email and must be presented to complete the reset process. Tokens are 64-character alphanumeric strings.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Expiration timestamp for this password reset token. Tokens are valid for exactly 60 minutes from creation time. After expiration, the token cannot be used for password reset.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this password reset request was generated. This is used for expiration calculations and audit trail.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this record was last updated. Usually when the token was used and before deletion.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp to maintain audit trail while allowing temporary data purging. Set to the timestamp when the token is successfully used and deleted from the system.

models.name: todo_app_user_email_verifications
models.description:
Temporary email verification tokens issued to newly registered users requiring confirmation of their email address.

System-generated records that enable users to complete account registration by verifying their email ownership through a secure, time-limited token link. Each token is uniquely associated with one user account and becomes invalid after expiration or successful verification.

The system automatically generates these tokens during user registration and sends them via email. After successful verification, the token is marked as deleted. Tokens have a fixed 2-hour expiration period for security.

These records are managed entirely by the authentication system - users cannot create, update, or delete them directly. They are automatically purged after expiration or verification.

foreignFields.name: user_id
foreignFields.description: The user account this verification belongs to. {@link todo_app_users.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique random token generated for email verification. This is the key component of the verification URL sent to the user's email address.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this verification record was created. This marks the beginning of the 2-hour expiration window.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this verification token expires. After this time, the token is no longer valid for verification. Fixed 2-hour expiration period as required by security policy.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this verification record was deleted (invalidated). This occurs when the verification is successfully completed, or when the record is manually cleared. NULL indicates the record is still active.

models.name: todo_app_guests
models.description:
Temporary guest accounts for unauthenticated users identified by device or browser fingerprint.

Represents transient users who interact with the system without authentication. Each guest is uniquely identified by a device or browser fingerprint, allowing the system to maintain session continuity during a single browsing session.

Guest accounts are temporary, automatically expire after a configurable period of inactivity, and have no access to personal data. They cannot create, read, or modify any business data like todo items. Their primary purpose is to enable anonymous interaction with public-facing features before account registration.

The system uses these tables to track guest usage patterns, monitor system load from anonymous users, and facilitate seamless transitions to authenticated user accounts.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this guest account was first created based on device fingerprint detection.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the most recent activity from this guest. Updated with each interaction.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this guest account was removed from the system. NULL indicates active guest account.

models.name: todo_app_guest_sessions
models.description:
Temporary session tokens for guest access with limited lifetime that expire after 60 minutes.

Tracks authentication sessions for unauthenticated users identified by device or browser fingerprint. Each session is uniquely tied to a guest account and terminates automatically after 60 minutes.

Stores connection metadata including IP address, connection URL, and referrer URL for security auditing and abuse detection. Sessions are append-only records that cannot be modified once created.

The expiration time is hardcoded to 60 minutes by system policy - sessions cannot be extended or remain active indefinitely for security reasons.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_guest_id
foreignFields.description: The guest account this session belongs to. {@link todo_app_guests.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client IP address from which the session was established.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: The URL of the page that initiated the session.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: The referrer URL that led to this session initiation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expires. Sessions are automatically terminated after 60 minutes per security policy.

models.name: todo_app_guest_password_resets
models.description:
Password reset tokens for guest users to recover forgotten passwords.

Provides secure, time-limited password recovery mechanism for unauthenticated guests. Each token is a unique cryptographic string that allows a guest to reset their password after a successful email-based verification flow.

Tokens are single-use and automatically invalidated upon successful password reset. The system creates a new token for each reset request, and expired tokens are purged automatically.

Each reset token is linked to a specific guest account via guest_id. The password reset workflow requires the guest to be redirected through an email verification link containing this token.

This table does not track password history or provide recovery options beyond the token-based reset mechanism.

foreignFields.name: guest_id
foreignFields.description: The guest account this password reset belongs to. {@link todo_app_guests.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique cryptographic token for password reset validation. Must be a 64-character random string generated by secure random algorithm.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Expiration timestamp for the password reset token. Must be set to 30-60 minutes after creation time as per system requirements for security.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this password reset token was created and issued to the guest.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last update to this record. Updated when token is consumed or invalidated.

models.name: todo_app_guest_email_verifications
models.description:
Email verification tokens for guest account activation during registration.

Stores temporary verification tokens sent to guest emails during registration. Each token is unique and expires within 24 hours as required by security policy. Used to confirm that the guest provided a valid email address during account creation.

Tokens are single-use and automatically invalidated after use or expiration. The system does not store the actual email address in this table for security reasons, instead linking the token to the guest account via the guest_id foreign key. Verification is completed through a secure token-based workflow, and no manual updates or deletions are performed on this table.

foreignFields.name: guest_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the guest account requiring email verification. {@link todo_app_guests.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Cryptographically secure random token used for verification. Must be unique. Generated at time of ticket creation and sent to guest email.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Expiration timestamp for the verification token. Set to 24 hours after creation as required by security policy. Tokens are automatically invalidated after this time.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the email verification token was created. Mandatory for audit trail and tracking token lifecycle.

models.name: todo_app_configurations
models.description:
Global system configuration settings such as token expiration duration, password complexity rules, and feature flags.

Stores application-wide configuration parameters that control system behavior without requiring code deployment. These settings are loaded at application startup and may be dynamically updated via administrative interfaces. All configuration values are stored as strings for maximum flexibility in handling different data types (numbers, booleans, JSON objects) via serialization.

plainFields.name: token_expiration_minutes
plainFields.description: Duration in minutes that JWT access tokens remain valid before requiring refresh. Default value is typically 15 minutes for security.

plainFields.name: password_min_length
plainFields.description: Minimum number of characters required for user passwords. Enforces basic password strength requirements to improve account security.

plainFields.name: password_require_uppercase
plainFields.description: Whether passwords must contain at least one uppercase letter. Part of the password complexity policy to enhance security.

plainFields.name: password_require_lowercase
plainFields.description: Whether passwords must contain at least one lowercase letter. Part of the password complexity policy to enhance security.

plainFields.name: password_require_numbers
plainFields.description: Whether passwords must contain at least one numeric digit. Part of the password complexity policy to enhance security.

plainFields.name: password_require_symbols
plainFields.description: Whether passwords must contain at least one special symbol. Part of the password complexity policy to enhance security.

plainFields.name: feature_flags
plainFields.description: JSON-encoded string containing key-value pairs for toggleable application features. Each key represents a feature name and value is a boolean indicating enabled/disabled status.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this configuration record was created. Used for auditing and change tracking of system settings.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this configuration record was last modified. Used to identify when system settings changed and for cache invalidation.

models.name: todo_app_feature_flags
models.description:
Toggleable application features that can be enabled or disabled at runtime without deployment.

Provides system-wide control over application functionality by allowing administrators to activate or deactivate features dynamically. Each feature is uniquely identified by name and can be toggled between enabled and disabled states. This enables safe experimentation, staged rollouts, and emergency feature disabling without code deployments.

The description field provides context about the feature's purpose and impact, helping administrators make informed decisions. Feature flags are critical for continuous delivery practices and risk mitigation in production environments.

plainFields.name: feature_name
plainFields.description: Unique identifier for the feature flag. Should be descriptive and follow naming convention (e.g., "new_checkout_flow", "dark_mode").

plainFields.name: enabled
plainFields.description: Current state of the feature flag. True indicates the feature is active and available. False indicates the feature is disabled.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of the feature's purpose, expected impact, and any known considerations. Used by administrators to understand the feature before enabling.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the feature flag was created in the system.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the feature flag was last modified (enabled/disabled status changed or description updated).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the feature flag was logically deleted. NULL indicates the flag is still active. Used for audit trail and potential recovery.

models.name: todo_app_application_metadata
models.description:
Application metadata containing version, build timestamp, and environment information for the todo_app system.

Tracks critical system configuration data including the current application version, build timestamp when deployed, and runtime environment (development, staging, production). This metadata is used for system diagnostics, version validation, and environment-specific configuration.

The table records immutable system state information that is updated during deployment processes. It is not directly user-managed but is essential for system integrity and monitoring.

plainFields.name: version
plainFields.description: Current application semantic version number in format MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH (e.g., 1.2.3).

plainFields.name: build_timestamp
plainFields.description: Timestamp of when this version of the application was built and deployed to the current environment.

plainFields.name: environment
plainFields.description: Current runtime environment of the application. Valid values: development, staging, production.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this metadata record was initially created in the database.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this metadata record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this metadata record was soft-deleted. Null indicates active record.

models.name: todo_app_todo_items
models.description:
Personal task items owned exclusively by a single user. Each todo represents a discrete unit of work that can be tracked to completion.

Stores individual todo items with strict ownership by a single user. Each item has a unique ID, title, description, status (pending/completed/archived), and timestamps for creation and updates. The userId field links to the authentication agent's user table, ensuring complete data isolation. Todo items are not shared between users and can only be accessed, modified, or deleted by their owner.

This is the primary business entity of the Todo application, supporting full CRUD operations with independent filtering and searching capabilities.

foreignFields.name: user_id
foreignFields.description: Owner of this todo item. {@link todo_app_users.id}.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Brief title for the todo item, maximum 255 characters.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of the todo item, maximum 10,000 characters. Optional field for additional context.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of the todo item. Valid values: pending, completed, archived.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this todo item was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last modification to this todo item.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this todo item was logically deleted (soft delete). NULL indicates active item.
